newsitem.title: CANADA: Thomson core profit, gains help earnings.
newsitem.headline: Thomson core profit, gains help earnings.

text.p: Thomson Corp tied its higher nine-month profit reported on Thursday to a rise in core earnings and higher net gains from asset sales.
The rise was offset partly by the earnings loss from those sales and the cost of acquisitions. Thomson said its earnings were hit by the June acquisition of West Publishing Co.

Thomson's nine-month earnings rose to US$334 million or US$0.56 a share from year earlier US$292 million or US$0.50 a share. Third-quarter profit rose to US$301 million or US$0.50 a share from US$281 million or US$0.48 a share in the prior year quarter.
Thomson said nine-month sales from its international publishing group were higher than in the prior year, while profits were flat.

"With a high proportion of revenues concentrated towards the end of the year and costs spread more evenly over the year, operating margins increase as the year proceeds and, as a consequence, improved full-year (international publishing) results are expected," Thomson said.
The company said operating results improved substantially in the financial and professional publishing group despite elevated business development spending.
